Vexed Gaming is an British esports organization. Originally formed as an esports subsidiary of eBettle, Vexed Gaming has hosted numerous European squads since its inception in 2015, including a Polish squad which attended DreamHack Cluj-Napoca 2015, a French squad, and a Swedish-British squad.

Timeline

  • Show All
  • September 16th - Team eBettle rebrands its gaming arm as Vexed Gaming, in order to avoid potential betting-related controversy. [1]
  • December 10th - Vexed Gaming release peet, while announcing that MINISE of ex-ESC will be standing in for them in the near future. [2] In actuality, repo begins playing as the teams fifth.
  • February 3rd - Vexed Gaming officially announce repo as the fifth member of the team [3] and the addition of KubiK as their coach. [4]
  • March 8th - Vexed Gaming releases their roster with immediate effect [5]. It is later revealed that Vexed would be shutting down all eSports operations. [6]
  • December 5th - Vexed Gaming re-enters CS:GO with the signing of the French team WE GOT GAME. [7]
  • February 4th - devoduvek is acquired by Team EnVyUs. [8]
  • February 19th - AmaNEk and hAdji are released from the team while AlluM3tt3 and Smyli join. NpK becomes an active player. [9]
  • March 13th - WiPR joins as analyst. [10]
  • May 1st - KQLY replaces AlluM3tt3 on a trial basis. [11] As a result of KQLY's addition Smyli and jarod exit the team[12], followed by their analyst WiPR. [13]
  • September 25th - Vexed Gaming finalises its roster. [14]
  • March 9th - Gauthierlele leaves Vexed Gaming. [15]
  • May 28th - Vexed Gaming parts ways with their French roster. [16]
  • September 9th - Vexed Gaming sign their new CS:GO squad consisting of pyth, hns, and the Vexed Gaming.uk core. Additionally, wh1sk joins as a substitute for UK-based events and sprayxd joins as coach. [17]
  • December 3rd - Vexed Gaming release wh1sk. [18]
  • January 16th - sprayxd steps down as Vexed Gaming's coach. [19]
  • January 28th - kolor replaces ozzy. [20]
  • March 12th - kolor is acquired by Budapest Five. [21]
  • May 8th - The Final Tribe acquire Vexed Gaming's roster. [22]
  • June 3rd - Vexed Gaming acquire London Esports' roster. [23]
  • July 23rd - SHANEY joins as a streamer. [24]
  • August 14th - Vexed Gaming bench frazehh. ec1s joins the team on a trial basis. [25]
  • December 16th - Vexed Gaming release ec1s. [26]
  • September 7th - frazehh leaves Vexed Gaming to join London Esports. [27]
  • January 29th - Vexed Gaming sign Russ. [28]
  • April 15th - Vexed Gaming release their team. [29]
  • April 26th - Vexed Gaming acquire Reason Gaming's roster. [30]
  • May 14th - Vexed Gaming part ways with their team due to personal issues within the squad. [31]
  • August 31st - Vexed Gaming acquire the lineup of Project 5 Esport. [32]
  • October 9th - Vexed Gaming part ways with shateri. [33]
  • October 22nd - Vexed Gaming signs EIZA. [34]
  • February 2nd - shyyne steps down from Vexed Gaming. isk joins on trial. [35]
  • March 1st - Vexed Gaming release their roster. [36]
